question: In which city was the AI ​​Action Summit 2025 held in February 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Paris, France**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **AI Action Summit 2025** was hosted by **France** in the city of **Paris** on **February 10 and 11, 2025**.
 
• This summit was the third major international gathering focused on **Artificial Intelligence** safety and governance, following the inaugural event in the **United Kingdom** and the subsequent session in **South Korea**.
 
• The primary objective of the **Paris Summit** was to transition from theoretical discussions and principles to concrete **global actions** regarding the ethical development and deployment of **AI technologies**.
 
• The event was championed by French President **Emmanuel Macron**, emphasizing **France's** ambition to become a global leader in **AI innovation** and regulation.
 
• The summit brought together **heads of state**, leaders of **international organizations**, representatives from **tech giants**, and **civil society** members to discuss five key themes: public interest AI, the future of work, **innovation**, **safety**, and global governance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Evolution of AI Summits:**

 
 
• The global dialogue on AI safety began with the **AI Safety Summit** at **Bletchley Park**, **United Kingdom**, in **November 2023**. This resulted in the historic **Bletchley Declaration**, signed by **28 countries** including **India**, the **USA**, and **China**.
 
• The second iteration, the **AI Seoul Summit**, was co-hosted by **South Korea** and the **UK** in **May 2024**, which expanded the focus to include **innovation** and **inclusivity** alongside safety.
 
 
 
• **Global Partnership on Artificial Intelligence (GPAI):**
 
 
• **GPAI** is an international initiative established to guide the responsible development and use of **AI**, grounded in **human rights**, inclusion, and **diversity**.
 
• **India** held the **Presidency** of **GPAI** for the year **2024**, hosting the **GPAI Summit** in **New Delhi** in **December 2023**.
 
 
 
• **UNESCO and AI Ethics:**
 
 
• **Paris** is also the headquarters of **UNESCO**, which in **2021** adopted the **Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence**, the first global standard-setting instrument on the subject.
 
• The **2025 Summit** in **Paris** leveraged this proximity to emphasize **multilateralism** and the role of **international law** in managing **frontier AI models**.
 
 
 
• **Key Definitions and Trends:**
 
 
• **Generative AI:** A type of **AI** system capable of generating text, images, or other media in response to prompts (e.g., **ChatGPT**, **Gemini**).
 
• **AI Governance:** The legal and policy framework intended to ensure **AI** benefits society while mitigating risks like **misinformation**, **job displacement**, and **autonomous weaponry**.
